summon:
Use case: identity-preserve
Asset type: production desktop pet pixel-art sprite sheet, one-shot summon / emerge action.
Input image 1: canonical accepted Pace idle frame. This is the identity, proportions, pixel-grid and costume target. Expand that exact character into eight sequential animation poses; do not redesign him.
Primary request: Pace pops up from a small hole in the ground, climbs and hops out, then stands in his exact familiar idle pose.
Layout: exactly 8 frames, 4 equal square cells across by 2 equal square cells down, playback left-to-right then top-to-bottom. 2048x1024 canvas, 512x512 cells. Every cell represents a 128x128 logical pixel canvas enlarged 4x with nearest-neighbor square blocks. Equal padding, no text, numbers, borders, dividers or annotations. All space outside the character and tiny hole must be genuinely transparent.
Canonical style: true coarse game pixel art, flat solid square pixel clusters, no antialiasing or soft alpha. Palette only dark outline #160404, gold #f9a80c, cream #fbeec5, red #dc0c1f, brown #54270b, highlight #fec310 and their exact shades visible in the reference. Keep original large broad head, small body, curved tail extending left, cheetah spots, cream muzzle and belly, red headband with ties, red-and-cream sneakers. Same friendly right-facing three-quarter view, same face and eye construction. Do not substitute a generic cat, plush toy, vector icon, rounded smooth drawing, or fur texture.
Coordinates below are logical 128x128 coordinates in EACH cell. Canonical full idle occupies approximately x=33..98, y=24..112. Shoes rest at y=112, shoes center x=75.5. Keep that anatomy and scale in all frames; no per-frame zoom, camera motion or whole-body shrinking. Pose changes and vertical emerging motion are intended.
Hole: one small flat horizontal dark brown/black oval at center x=75, floor y=111, maximum width 41 and depth 7 logical pixels, only a thin uneven brown soil rim. It is a ground opening, not a bucket, mound, pedestal or tunnel arch. The rim consistently occludes parts below the ground. No large earth patch or shadows outside the rim. Keep hole center/floor fixed in every frame.
Ordered frames:
1. The small closed-earth seam opens into a tiny dark oval, Pace fully below ground, just a few square brown crumbs.
2. Pace's ears, spiky hair, red headband and curious eyes peek above the open rim. The rest of his head and body remain below ground.
3. His full familiar head is above the hole, both paws rest on the rim, torso still below.
4. He pulls up, head and upper torso emerge, cream belly visible, lower torso and sneakers still hidden by the rim.
5. He pushes with his paws into a compact whole-body crouch just above the rim, sneakers now visible, correct-sized head and tail.
6. A small happy hop clears the hole, entire character airborne only about 8 logical pixels above the canonical floor, tail curved left, hole beneath.
7. He lands softly with knees bent at the canonical floor, hole contracts behind his shoes.
8. Exact familiar canonical idle standing pose at x/y/scale of the reference, relaxed paws by sides, shoes at y=112; hole fully closed and ground fragments gone.
Constraints: truly distinct drawn poses, smooth readable one-way action, no duplicate characters within a cell, no cross-cell pixels, no dropped headband, no missing sneakers or tail when fully emerged, no added clothes, no gradient, no glow, no drop shadow. Fully preserve the recognizable Pace identity. Transparent background.
